verdict.rationale: CHKit is ObsessionDB's own tooling for describing, validating, testing, and deploying schema and pipelines as code, run in CI with a reviewable diff. That covers versioning and review of pipeline automations. Rollback of those automations is not documented: point-in-time recovery and time travel restore data, not automation definitions, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented rollback of pipelines and automations, explicit version history for automation definitions (alert rules, refreshable views), in-depth CHKit docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
